subject: Hand carving a block
parts: three clearly separated parts: one bent single-line stick figure arm (exactly one open L-shaped stroke, no enclosing outline) in the upper left, one hollow broad chisel angled down-right with a full stroke-width white gap from the arm end, and one wide rectangular block below with a broad V-shaped carving notch aligned to the chisel tip and a full stroke-width white gap from it
warnings: Strokes remain thinner than the requested SOLO48 weight. The hand is represented by a single-line stick figure arm as required by the skill.
